Provide a clear and concise description of the changes made in this pull request. Explain what problem this solves or what feature it implements.

## Type of Change
Please select the type of change:
- [ ] Bug fix (fixes an existing issue without changing functionality)
- [ ] Feature (adds new functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (a change that causes existing functionality to work differently)
- [ ] Documentation update (changes to docs, comments, or similar)
- [ ] Refactoring (code changes that don't affect behavior)

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`pytest` for Python, `npm test` for TypeScript/React)
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines (no em dashes or en dashes in text, use commas or periods)
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint` for TypeScript/React)
- [ ] No new warnings have been introduced
- [ ] Changes are backwards compatible (or breaking changes are documented)
